description:
Managed in Partnership with Skmana Ski Club Society, the snowshoe trail network offers over 5 km of trails surrounding beautiful wetlands and intimate twin lakes.

Visit Skmana Ski and Snoeshoe Club's website for current winter conditions and other updates.
directions:
Located about an hour East of Kamloops.
